data.title: Reversal of AI capex could throw the U.S. economy into a recession: CIO
data.description: Jevons Global's Kingsley Jones warns that the shrinking of capex numbers is almost impossible to avoid but it won’t happen anytime soon. He also says that while we might see an erosion of margins, forward guidance on AI spend will be key in deciding whether the general economy will go into recession.
